knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Enquiries per hour of effort uses recorded counts over the same period. Feel and audience size do not show what a channel produces for the effort spent.
The entry offer is the first, low-commitment step. The most expensive programme and the loyal-client product belong to other stages.

The bottleneck is where most people are lost. Reviewing the trial and the offer that follows addresses that step. More leads add people to the same leak, and a zero price does not show that the offer works.

practicalCriteria: Given 30 days of supplied channel data, the learner calculates enquiries per hour for each channel, and the assessor recalculates two and agrees
The learner completes a four-stage funnel and identifies the largest percentage drop-off, which the assessor confirms from the counts
The learner writes one change for the bottleneck with a 30-day review date
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed funnel with the bottleneck marked
stopWorkCriteria: Stop any paid campaign that makes an outcome claim not yet checked (see the claims lesson)
Stop any electronic campaign with no consent record (see the contact lesson)
